text:
deploy-bot: Kickoff: wave-43 is starting for api, runtime, console, router. change-window 03:00-04:00Z. Initial canary 5% in us-west-2. :calendar:

maya: FYI the api auth token prefix is changing from 'rwd:' -> 'rw:' to save header bytes. runtime needs decoder patch (v4.0.0) to accept both prefixes. router can pass-through tokens unchanged but has optional validation flag. console will start emitting new prefix in the next build.

rick: is there a compatibility window? clients might still send old tokens for a few days. we need a documented shim timeline and rollback plan.

liang: propose runtime pin to v3.9.x for the wave (backwards-compatible) while api and console roll. then upgrade runtime to v4.0.0 after router validation toggled.

sofia: can we avoid any schema work? this is header/token format only, no DB changes. confirm no migrations.

tom: confirmed — no migrations. just auth parsing change.

maya: i'm going to open a confluence note + client-facing blurb. will include dates for old-token acceptance (48h) and deprecation.

deploy-bot: Executing pin:
```
/deploy pin runtime v3.9.7 --wave wave-43 --reason "auth token prefix compatibility"
```

deploy-bot: Canary set to 10% per rfc. Observability alert hooks enabled. :white_check_mark:

rick: rollback triggers suggestion: if auth failures (401/403) increase >0.5% for 5m OR p99 latency +300ms for 5m, immediate rollback. also abort any router validation flip if auth failure spike during stage.

liang: router team: can you hold validation flag off until console confirms new prefix live + smoke test passes? need explicit unpin checklist:
- confluence URL in thread
- console build tag (sha)
- smoke test: 200 auth requests mixing prefixes, success rate >= 99.5%

sofia: i'll run smoke tests and capture logs.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics (7m): auth 401=0.02%, p99 latency delta +8ms. No triggers. monitoring started at 6321007890.

maya: confluence published: https://confluence.redwood/releases/wave-43/auth-prefix-migration (draft)

sofia: smoke tests running now. will post summary in ~6m.

rick: let's also call out where API keys are issued (console -> user-service) in the notes so support can triage client questions.

sofia: smoke test done: 200 requests (mix 70/30 old/new) -> 199/200 successes (99.5%). logs show fallback decoder used on 1 request (old prefix), token accepted. attaching sanitized output. :white_check_mark:

liang: checklist satisfied. router can start staged rollout to enable strict validation after we confirm client-facing notice sent. suggest staged percentages: 5,25,75,100.

maya: client-facing blurb published to support: https://support.redwood/announcements/auth-prefix-deprecate (published).

deploy-bot: Scheduling router validation flip:
```
/deploy roll router v2.13.0 --stages 5,25,75,100 --wave wave-43 --flag enable-auth-strict=true
```

rick: observability team, please monitor auth 4xx/5xx closely for the next 30m. escalate to #eng-oncall on anomalies.

tom: i'll keep runtime pin for 2 hours after router full stage then plan to upgrade runtime to v4.0.0 if stable.

deploy-bot: wave-43 status: in-progress; runtime pinned v3.9.7; router rolling v2.13.0 (stage 5%). updates will follow.
